##导入文档，进行描述性统计
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
dat_raw <- read_csv("D:\\new\\0.2\\r\\R_final\\final_3\\data_replicate.csv")
head(dat_raw)
##计算YA(年轻人)在weeks, years, past, future 四种条件下的internal details得分的平均数和标准差；
##OA(老年人)在weeks, years, past, future 四种条件下的internal details得分的平均数和标准差；
##YA(年轻人)在weeks, years, past, future 四种条件下的external details得分的平均数和标准差；
##OA(老年人)在weeks, years, past, future 四种条件下的exyernal details得分的平均数和标准差。
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
dat_raw <- dat_raw %>%
  mutate(GRUPO = factor(GRUPO, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("YA","OA")))
dat_raw <- dat_raw %>%
  mutate(
    INT_years = PL_int + FL_int,          
    EXT_weeks = PC_ext + FC_ext,
    EXT_years = PL_ext + FL_ext,
    EXT_Past  = PC_ext + PL_ext,
    EXT_Fut   = FC_ext + FL_ext
  )
table1 <- dat_raw %>%
  group_by(GRUPO) %>%
  summarise(
    ##Internal
    INT_weeks_M = mean(INT_weeks), INT_weeks_SD = sd(INT_weeks),
    INT_years_M = mean(INT_years), INT_years_SD = sd(INT_years),
    INT_Past_M  = mean(INT_Past),  INT_Past_SD  = sd(INT_Past),
    INT_Fut_M   = mean(INT_Fut),   INT_Fut_SD   = sd(INT_Fut),
    ##External
    EXT_weeks_M = mean(EXT_weeks), EXT_weeks_SD = sd(EXT_weeks),
    EXT_years_M = mean(EXT_years), EXT_years_SD = sd(EXT_years),
    EXT_Past_M  = mean(EXT_Past),  EXT_Past_SD  = sd(EXT_Past),
    EXT_Fut_M   = mean(EXT_Fut),   EXT_Fut_SD   = sd(EXT_Fut)
  )
table1_long <- table1 %>%
  pivot_longer(-GRUPO, 
               names_to = c("condition", "stat"), 
               names_pattern = "(.*)_(M|SD)") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(GRUPO, stat), values_from = value)

table1_long %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
##保留1位小数
table1_long %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.1f", .x))) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```


##混合方差分析
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(afex) 
dat_raw <- read_csv("D:\\new\\0.2\\r\\R_final\\final_3\\data_replicate.csv")
names(dat_raw)
##数据宽转长，每个被试4行
dat_anova <- dat_raw %>%
  select(ID_part, GRUPO, PC_int, PL_int, FC_int, FL_int) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = PC_int:FL_int,
    names_to = "condition",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = recode(condition,
                       "PC_int" = "past_weeks",
                       "PL_int" = "past_years",
                       "FC_int" = "future_weeks",
                       "FL_int" = "future_years")
  ) %>%
  separate(condition, into = c("direction", "period"), sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("past", "future")),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("weeks", "years")),
    GRUPO = factor(GRUPO, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("YA","OA")),
    ID_part = as.factor(ID_part)
  ) %>%
  na.omit()
nrow(dat_anova)
##运行方差分析
library(afex)
aov_result <- aov_ez(
  id = "ID_part",
  dv = "count",
  between = "GRUPO",
  within = c("direction", "period"),
  data = dat_anova,
  anova_table = list(es = "pes")
)
summary(aov_result)
##补充YA和OA组的M和SD
tot_int <- dat_anova %>%
  group_by(ID_part, GRUPO) %>%
  summarise(total_internal = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
desc <- tot_int %>%
  group_by(GRUPO) %>%
  summarise(
    M = mean(total_internal),
    SD = sd(total_internal)
  )
print(desc)
##计算η²（此处为偏η²）
library(effectsize)
eta_sq <- eta_squared(aov_result, partial = TRUE)
print("提取的偏η²:")
print(eta_sq)
##方差分析绘图
##图a
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
stats_summary <- dat_anova %>%
  group_by(GRUPO, direction) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(count),
    SD = sd(count),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
stats_ttest <- dat_anova %>%
  group_by(ID_part, GRUPO) %>%
  summarise(Total_Int = sum(count), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  t.test(Total_Int ~ GRUPO, data = .)
p_a <- ggplot(stats_summary, aes(x = direction, y = Mean, fill = GRUPO)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SD, ymax = Mean + SD),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(0.7)
  ) +
  ##标注p 值
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("past", "future")), # 比较 Past 和 Future
    map_signif_level = TRUE, 
    test = NULL,
    annotations = "*",
    y_position = max(stats_summary$Mean) * 1.1, # 星号位置
    vjust = -0.5,
    textsize = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("YA" = "lightgray", "OA" = "darkgray")) +
  labs(x = "Temporal Direction", y = "Mean Number of Internal Details") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
##图b
stats_dir_only <- dat_anova %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(count), SD = sd(count), .groups = 'drop')

p_b <- ggplot(stats_dir_only, aes(x = direction, y = Mean)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "gray50", width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SD, ymax = Mean + SD),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  ##标注p值
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("past", "future")),
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    test = NULL,
    annotations = "*",
    y_position = max(stats_dir_only$Mean) * 1.1,
    vjust = -0.5,
    textsize = 5
  ) +
  labs(x = "Temporal Direction", y = "Mean Number of Internal Details") +
  theme_classic()
##展示所有图
library(patchwork)
final_plot <- (p_a + p_b) 
print(final_plot)
##YA和OA组间比较
stats_swap <- dat_total %>%
group_by(detail_type, GRUPO) %>%
summarise(Mean = mean(total_score), SD = sd(total_score), .groups = "drop")
p_swap <- ggplot(stats_swap, aes(x = detail_type, y = Mean, fill = GRUPO)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.6) + geom_errorbar(
aes(ymin = Mean - SD, ymax = Mean + SD),
width = 0.2,
position = position_dodge(0.7)
) + geom_signif(
xmin = 1 - 0.15,
xmax = 1 + 0.15,
y_position = max(stats_swap$Mean) * 1.1, 
annotation = "***",
tip_length = 0.02,
textsize = 5
) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("YA" = "lightgray", "OA" = "darkgray")) + labs(x = "Detail Type", y = "Mean Number of Details", fill = "Age Group") +
theme_classic()
print(p_swap)
```

## Including Plots


##相关分析
```{r}
##dat_replicate已导入
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)  
##筛选老年人数据，并计算所需变量
dat_oa <- dat_raw %>%
  filter(GRUPO == 2) %>%  # 假设 GRUPO=2 是老年人
  mutate(
    INT_Past = PC_int + PL_int,          # 过去内部细节
    INT_Fut  = FC_int + FL_int,          # 未来内部细节
    EXT_Past = PC_ext + PL_ext,          # 过去外部细节
    EXT_Fut  = FC_ext + FL_ext           # 未来外部细节
  ) %>%
  select(ID_part, VPA, INT_Past, INT_Fut, EXT_Past, EXT_Fut)
##进行四个相关分析
cor_results <- list(
  cor.test(dat_oa$VPA, dat_oa$INT_Past, method = "pearson"),
  cor.test(dat_oa$VPA, dat_oa$INT_Fut,  method = "pearson"),
  cor.test(dat_oa$VPA, dat_oa$EXT_Past, method = "pearson"),
  cor.test(dat_oa$VPA, dat_oa$EXT_Fut,  method = "pearson")
)
names(cor_results) <- c("VPA_INT_Past", "VPA_INT_Fut", "VPA_EXT_Past", "VPA_EXT_Fut")
for (i in seq_along(cor_results)) {
  cat("\n", names(cor_results)[i], ":\n")
  print(cor_results[[i]])
}

##绘制四个散点图
dat_oa_long <- dat_oa %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(INT_Past, INT_Fut, EXT_Past, EXT_Fut),
    names_to = "detail_type",
    values_to = "details_score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    detail_label = case_when(
      detail_type == "INT_Past" ~ "Internal Past",
      detail_type == "INT_Fut"  ~ "Internal Future",
      detail_type == "EXT_Past" ~ "External Past",
      detail_type == "EXT_Fut"  ~ "External Future"
    )
  )


p_scatter <- ggscatter(
  dat_oa_long, 
  x = "VPA", 
  y = "details_score",
  add = "reg.line",
  conf.int = TRUE,
  color = "detail_label",
  palette = "jco",
  shape = "detail_label",
  size = 2,
  alpha = 0.6
) +
  stat_cor(aes(color = detail_label), label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top") +
  facet_wrap(~ detail_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "VPA Score (Verbal Paired Associates)",
    y = "Number of Details",
    color = "Detail Type",
    shape = "Detail Type"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

print(p_scatter)
```



##拓展分析1：方差齐性检验
```{r}
##数据重新宽转长，并保存
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
dat_raw <- read_csv("D:\\new\\0.2\\r\\R_final\\final_3\\data_replicate.csv")
dat_long <- dat_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = PC_int:FL_ext,                     
    names_to = c("direction", "period", "detail"),   ##新的列名
    names_pattern = "(P|F)(C|L)_(int|ext)",            ##正则：第一个字母(P/F)，第二个字母(C/L)，下划线后(int/ext)
    values_to = "count"                             
  )
dat_long <- dat_long %>%
  mutate(
    direction = recode(direction, P = "past", F = "future"),
    period    = recode(period, C = "weeks", L = "years"),
    detail    = recode(detail, int = "internal", ext = "external")
  )
head(dat_long, 10)
write_csv(dat_long, "D:\\new\\0.2\\r\\R_final\\final_3\\dat_long.csv")
cat("文件已保存到指定路径\n")

##导入宽转长后的数据
dat_ext <- dat_long %>% filter(detail == "ext")
dat_ext$GRUPO <-as.factor(dat_ext$GRUPO)
car::leveneTest(count ~ GRUPO, data = dat_ext)
t_ext <- t.test(count ~ GRUPO, data = dat_ext)
print(t_ext)
```

##拓展分析3：LLM重新计算ANOVA
```{r}
dat_int <- dat_long %>% filter(detail == "int")
m <- lmer(count ~ GRUPO * direction * period + (1 | ID_part), data = dat_int)
summary(m)
##对交互作用进行简单效应分析
library(emmeans)
emm <- emmeans(m, ~ GRUPO | direction)
pairs(emm, adjust = "bonferroni")
```


Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
